svg.text: Highway drive-thru prototype — concept design (RIBA Stage 2)
Scale 1:100 @ A1 · dimensions in metres unless noted
Site geometry is a generic M4 roadside parcel; adapt to
topographic survey, title plan and Roads Dept. junction approval.
Cladding: Armenian volcanic tuff, sawn 900x300x30 mm, apricot/rose blend,
Frames: Anodised aluminium, dark bronze (thermally broken). Glazing: Low-iron
Roof: hyperbolic paraboloid (ruled bilinear surface) - glulam/steel ruled
framing, oak batten soffit; soffit Thermally-modified oak / ash battens 70x30
mm @ 100 mm; fascia Folded aluminium 450 mm, dark bronze, integrated LED line.
Clerestory band between tuff walls and roof soffit makes the roof read as a
floating plane; LED reveal at the fascia for night identity.
Signage subject to Armenian Law on Language (Armenian text primary) and
